name: Benchmarking DNA Foundation Models
description: An evaluation suite measuring performance of DNA/foundational sequence models across genomic and genetic prediction tasks.
reputation: Emerging specialized benchmark gaining attention in genomics and computational biology communities for evaluating DNA foundation models.
notes: Risk of dataset contamination and sequence-similarity leakage between train/test splits; label noise and species bias; heterogeneous task set (classification and regression), not a pure LLM benchmark.
